inputs.caption:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 72. key is D, and scale is major. Indie Folk / Ballad.
Global Emotional Progression: Calm and settled from the start, a quiet resolution that fades with a sense of rest.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: A lantern in a window at dusk; the end of a long day by the sea.
Sonics & Production Profile: Intimate and narrow, warm and soft at the top end, very gentle dynamics.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Singer A (Female). A warm, slightly breathy alto with a soft, close-miked intimacy.
Vocal Style: Gentle and conversational, rising to a fuller, open tone on the chorus lines.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: A single soft harmony on the last chorus only.
Vocal FX: A short, warm room reverb; no audible pitch correction.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: A soft upright piano plays slow, open chords throughout.
Secondary: The acoustic guitar from earlier returns with a few sparse harmonics near the end.
Groove & Foundation Progression: No drums. The pulse comes from the piano chords alone.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: A long, soft room tail on the final chord.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Leave the lantern burning low
Tide comes home and so will I

[Outro]
So will I
